stemMd: According to the passage, why do staff test seed samples periodically?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To count every seed without opening the container

options.label: B
options.textMd: To prevent all future plant reproduction

options.label: C
options.textMd: To assess whether the batch still contains enough seeds capable of germinating

options.label: D
options.textMd: To replace the storage room's cooling equipment

options.label: E
options.textMd: To ensure every seed has identical genes

explanationMd: Germination testing reveals viability and triggers renewal when too few seeds germinate. It is not a complete count or a test of identical genetic composition.

distractorRationale.a: The test samples germination rather than counting every seed.
